Create a SAM template (template.yaml) in the 'app' folder. The template should define a basic AWS SAM application with a Lambda function (e.g., using Python runtime) and any necessary IAM role permissions. Include a simple API Gateway event trigger (GET /) for the Lambda. Ensure the template follows standard SAM structure and can be built and deployed using 'sam build' and 'sam deploy'.
